{{Otheruses|Nihil}}
'''Nihil smokestone''' was a mineral native to the [[Nihil Retreat]] that had the ability to act as a mental transmitter and receiver. The [[Sorcerers of Rhand]] used it to control [[Pawn]]s by imprinting [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] with it. This was usually done via skull implants or removable cranial harnesses. When a Sorcerer wore a [[Shadow Crown|shadow crown]] made of smokestone, they gained the ability to receive the collective sensory input of their Pawns and could give them primal commands such as kill, run, or feed. Individual Pawns could also be directly controlled like the marionettes of a puppeteer.<ref>''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> 

[[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]] was able to replicate the abilities of Nihil smokestone with the [[meltmassif]] of [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].<ref>[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor|''Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor'']]</ref>

[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] son [[Triclops]] was fitted with a mind-control device that duplicated the effects of Nihil smokestone.<ref>[[The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|''The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified'']]</ref>
